title: Squinting at tiny text? Press 2 keys 🔍 #Shorts
description:
Text on a web page too small to read? Hold Ctrl and tap + until it's big enough.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Plus (+)
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Plus (+)
📱 iPhone / Android: pinch outward with two fingers (some pages block this)

Ctrl + Minus zooms out, and Ctrl + 0 resets to the default size (Cmd on Mac).

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
